# 3A Technology Solutions & 3A Techvolution Academy

> 3A Technology Solutions develops practical digital solutions for businesses and institutions, builds business websites and landing pages, creates custom software and AI-enabled tools, and supports academic and research projects across Nigeria and Africa. 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY is our AI-focused educational academy teaching AI fluency, prompt engineering, vibe coding, and practical AI applications.

## Official Contact, Office Locations & Service Coverage
- **Official Business Email:** [3aafricanai@gmail.com](mailto:3aafricanai@gmail.com)
- **Head Office (Official Headquarters):** Agbo Area, Olunlade, Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria.
- **Branch Office 1:** Kola Balogun Area, Osogbo, Osun State, Nigeria.
- **Branch Office 2:** Dominion College, Behind Health Centre, Oba-Ile, Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria.
- **Service Coverage:** Serving Businesses and Individuals Across Nigeria (all states and the Federal Capital Territory) and Africa.

## 3A Technology Solutions — Commercial Services
- [Commercial Services Overview](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services): Overview of our six core technology, consulting, and academic research support services.
- [Web & Digital Product Development](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/web-development): Corporate websites, school and institutional websites, landing pages, customer portals, web applications, and digital platforms.
- [Custom Software Engineering](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/custom-software): Custom business applications, administrative systems, school management portals, payment/result management systems, digital record management, and APIs.
- [Artificial Intelligence & Automation](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/ai-automation): AI integration into business processes, AI-powered applications, knowledge assistants, business workflow automation, document extraction, and AI readiness assessments.
- [Data Science & Analytics](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/data-science-analytics): Data extraction, cleaning, visualization, statistical analysis, machine learning, predictive modelling, computer vision, and data-driven research support.
- [Technology Consulting](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/technology-consulting): Digital transformation planning, systems architecture review, technology stack advisory, process auditing, and technical feasibility roadmaps.
- [Academic Research & Project Support](https://3atechnology.com.ng/services/academic-research-support): Ethical research consultation, technical mentorship, Python/ML/computational modelling implementation, and technical report/defence preparation for computing and mathematics projects.

## Portfolio Collections (`/projects`)
1. **Business & Client Solutions:**
   - **MarketMind AI — Akinmart Store (`/projects/marketmind-ai`):** Internal AI-enabled business operations tool developed for Akinmart Store to support supermarket operations.
   - **Dominion College School Management Portal (`/projects/dominion-college-portal`):** Private institutional school management platform supporting school fee payments, student result checking, and academic administration (project link confidential).
2. **Websites & Digital Experiences:**
   - **Raph2 Interiors — Business Website & Landing Page (`/projects/raph2-interiors`):** Live client website (`https://raph2-interior.netlify.app/`) with interactive square-meter cost estimator, portfolio showcase, and WhatsApp enquiry flows.
   - **Dominion College School Management Portal (`/projects/dominion-college-portal`):** Institutional web portal case study (confidential deployment).
   - **Custom Digital Wedding Invitation & Gatepass Platform (`/projects/custom-wedding-invitation-platform`):** Bespoke digital event invitation experience with unique invitation cards and downloadable guest gatepasses (confidential deployment).
3. **Student & Research Projects:**
   - Selected academic and research projects (**Medicinal Plant Leaf Recognition**, **Image Compression & Analysis — RLE vs DCT**, **Deforestation & Canopy Change Analysis**) plus the wider student repository collection at `https://github.com/psalm001`.

## 3A TECHVOLUTION ACADEMY — Learn. Build. Advance.
- [Academy Overview](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy): Practical technology education, AI skills development, and academic and industrial training support for the next generation of technology professionals.
- [Learning Pathways](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/pathways): Five audience-based pathways — AI for Beginners, AI for Students & Researchers, AI for Graduates & NYSC Members, AI for Professionals & Businesses, and AI Development & Vibe Coding.
- [AI & Technology Courses](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/programmes): Structured courses separating permanent curriculum definitions from cohort/intake schedules.
- [IT / SIWES Training Support](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/siwes-support): Practical technology skill development, weekly guided tasks, and SIWES logbook/report mentorship for university and polytechnic students.
- [Academic Project Support](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/project-support): Separate ethical consultation and technical mentorship for undergraduate and postgraduate computing, AI, data science, and mathematics projects.
- [Customized Training](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/corporate-training): Tailored AI adoption and technology training for organizations, institutions, schools, and communities.
- [AI Seminars & Workshops](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/events): AI awareness programmes, fluency webinars, NYSC educational sessions, student technology seminars, and practical workshops.
- [Vibe Coding & AI-Assisted Development](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/vibe-coding): Learn how to build, understand, debug, and prototype real software responsibly using AI coding tools and agents.
- [AI Learning Resource Hub](https://3atechnology.com.ng/academy/resources): Growing educational library with transparent availability statuses (Available, Coming Soon, In Development).
